name: Coexistence

subjectOf.text: The authors adopt Schilling and Uhlig's result that official money and cryptocurrencies can co-exist in a manner consistent with stability, rejecting the framing that private currency and central bank money are necessarily mutually exclusive.
subjectOf.abstract: For our purposes, the important result is that it is possible for official money and cryptocurrencies to co-exist in a manner consistent with stability.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396522
scope_conditions: drawn from a model with decentralized Bitcoin production and a Dollar supply controlled to an inflation target

subjectOf.text: Development of blockchain based processes will take several years if not decades, so the most likely outcome is that legacy and blockchain based issuance, trading, and settlement systems coexist side by side for the foreseeable future.
subjectOf.abstract: will take several years if not decades, and so the most likely circumstance is that legacy and blockchain-based securities issuance, trading, settlement, and related systems and processes will have to co-exist side-by-side for the foreseeable future.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
scope_conditions: transition period for securities market infrastructure

description: 2 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'coexistence'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
